1. Enterprise SA Selection Decision Tree (R589)
Signed Blender MCP, Google Flow Veo 3.1 CLI, ACP Multiplexer & Gateway
Q1: Safe Blender MCP Without Arbitrary Python Exec?
• HoldMyBeer-gg/blenderwright (★201, MIT, Python):
Hundreds of structured tools over signed local socket
Raw Python execution OFF by default; visual & mesh QA
• Works with Claude, Cursor, Codex, Ollama & llama.cpp
Q2: Veo 3.1 & Nano Banana MCP/CLI on Existing Flow Credits?
• ffroliva/gflow-cli (★427, MIT, Python PyPI):
MCP server + CLI for Google Flow (Veo 3.1, Omni video,
Nano Banana & Imagen) from Claude Code, Cursor or Codex
• Billed directly to existing Google account Flow subscription
Q3: Durable Cross-Machine Coding Agent Control Plane?
• BrokkAi/mjolnir (★119, GPL-3.0, Rust):
Manages Claude Code, Codex, Kimi, Grok, Muse, OpenCode & DSH
Migrate live sessions across accounts, agents or SSH/EC2 hosts
• Set [jev] enabled = false in config.toml for zero cloud egress
Q4: 50+ Provider Rust AI Gateway + x402 Payment Rails?
• AlephantAI/AIephant-AI-Agent-Gateway (★119, GPL-3.0, Rust):
OpenAI-compatible routing across 50+ providers & 320+ models
Response caching, policy enforcement, member quota tracking
• Publishes agent capabilities as paid endpoints via x402 & MPP
2. End-to-End Enterprise Agent Control Plane, Rust Gateway & 3D/Video MCP Architecture
Four-Pillar Stack: Alephant 320-Model Gateway ➔ Mjolnir Durable Sessions ➔ Blenderwright Signed 3D MCP ➔ GFlow Veo 3.1 CLI
Pillar A: Signed Blender MCP (HoldMyBeer-gg/blenderwright)
• Security-First Transport: Signed local socket with raw
arbitrary Python execution disabled by default
• Hundreds of Structured Tools: Modeling, procedural materials,
emissive volumes, metaballs, keyframes, drivers & cameras
• Closed-Loop Quality Inspection: Built-in visual viewport
feedback and automated mesh topology quality analysis
• Broad Client Support: Claude, Cursor, Codex, Ollama, llama.cpp
✓ Eliminates unsafe exec() eval risks in legacy Blender MCPs
Pillar B: Google Flow MCP & CLI (ffroliva/gflow-cli)
• Dual Interface: MCP server + CLI (`uv tool install gflow-cli`)
• Flagship Media Models: Generates Veo 3.1 & Omni video plus
Nano Banana & Imagen images directly from coding agents
• Cost Arbitrage: Billed to existing Google account Flow
subscription credits rather than separate per-second Vertex billing
• Cross-Platform MIT: Runs on macOS, Windows & Linux
• IDE Integration: Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Codex
✓ Brings Veo 3.1 & Nano Banana directly into agent workflows
Pillar C: Durable ACP Control Plane (BrokkAi/mjolnir)
• Multi-Harness Fleet: Manages Claude Code, Codex, Kimi Code,
Grok Build, Muse Code, OpenCode & DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
• Hot Session Migration: Move a live session to another account,
another model harness, or another SSH/EC2 host without restart
• Persistent Execution: Keeps agents working across terminal
disconnects on laptops, Docker containers, SSH & EC2
• Privacy Gate: Disable hosted Jev classifier (`[jev] enabled = false`)
✓ Zero context loss when switching exhausted agent accounts
Pillar D: 320-Model Rust Gateway (AIephant-AI-Agent-Gateway)
• Unified Routing: Single OpenAI-compatible Rust 2024 gateway
covering 50+ providers, 320+ models & custom local backends
• Enterprise FinOps & Governance: Response caching, per-member
and per-workflow usage tracking, quota caps & policy controls
• Agent Monetization Rails: Publishes internal or external
agent capabilities as paid endpoints over x402 & MPP rails
• Dual Build Modes: External & internal deployment editions
✓ Centralizes 320+ LLM routing, caching & x402 chargeback
3. Closed-Form FinOps TCO Verification (CLAIM-20261120-R30-R589-BLENDERWRIGHT-GFLOWCLI-MJOLNIR-ALEPHANTGATEWAY · 44 Eng @ $100/h)
Path A: Commercial 3D Add-Ons + Gateway SaaS + Manual Ops
• Commercial Gateway SaaS & Media APIs: $3,220.00 / mo
• Session Restart & 3D Rework: 40.0 h/mo × $100.00/h = $4,000.00 / mo
• Overhead: Unsafe raw-Python Blender sockets, lost context
when quota hits mid-task & 5-10% commercial gateway markups
Path C: Hybrid OSS (Blenderwright + GFlow + Mjolnir + Alephant)
• Self-Hosted Gateway & Flow Credits: $75.00 / mo
• Gateway & Fleet Supervision: 2.4 h/mo × $100.00/h = $240.00 / mo
• Outcome: Signed Blender MCP, Veo 3.1/Nano Banana CLI,
live cross-account agent migration & 320-model Rust gateway
Verified Closed-Form ROI & Governance Summary
• Monthly Net Savings: $6,905.00 / mo (-95.64%)
• Annualized Savings: $82,860.00 / yr
• License Gate: blenderwright & gflow-cli = MIT; mjolnir &
Alephant = GPL-3.0 (deploy as network/CLI boundary services)
